# `core/framepipeline/FrameContext.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/framepipeline/FrameContext.js`

FrameContext — Per-frame shared state passed to every pipeline stage. The engine provides a minimal base context with timing and GPU fields. Consumers (editor, game) extend it with their own fields via the overrides parameter. Usage: const ctx = createFrameContext({ dt: 0.016, currentTime: performance.now(), device: gpuDevice, camera: myCamera, editor: editorApp, scene: editorApp.scene, }); pipeline.execute(ctx);

## Functions

### `createFrameContext(overrides)`

Create a per-frame context object.

**Parameters:**

- `[overrides]` *(Object)* — Consumer-specific fields merged into the context

**Returns:** FrameContext
